None of the three shaded squares lies on any of these axes, so each must generate an orbit of \(8\) symmetric squares under the full symmetry group of the square.

The three initial squares lie in three distinct orbits, so the minimal symmetric shaded set must contain
\[
3\cdot 8=24
\]
shaded squares total. Since \(3\) are already shaded, the number to add is
\[
24-3=21.
\]

\[
\boxed{21}
